warning_texts: Country is a candidate confounder the channel tests do not adjust for; mix is nearly even (direct share 0.550/0.555/0.552 in CZ/DE/PL) and the sign does not reverse inside those strata.
gate_claims_machine has no deterministic rule that the R05 caveat must state unreadability, which is why the false completeness sentence survived the machine gate.
CLM-AOV-* population names delivered but still does not name net of refunds, so even a caveats-only fix would leave the population field short of the formula.
summary: Independent quarantine recalc matches the eight registered figures (net revenue 3023296.61, orders 44531, completion 0.724397/0.604746, AOV 110.64/87.27, both tests). R05 names shipping_total but states the export's shipping cells were all readable and the total was omitted for brevity; 2648 of 44531 population shipping cells are unreadable (share 0.059464) and that is why shipping_total is excused. CLM-AOV-* caveats omit delivered-only and net of refunds. CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV publishes a full-channel population while the Welch test ran on delivered rows only.
